versions.description_html:
Azure Virtual Desktop runs your Windows desktops up in Microsoft's cloud, not on the laptop in front of you. The name makes it sound like one big product, but it's really a handful of simple pieces, and each piece has a plain job.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What Azure Virtual Desktop Actually Is
  • The Pieces You Actually Touch
  • Two Ways to Hand Out a Desktop
  • Where Your Files Live When the Machine Isn't Yours
  • How a User Actually Connects
  • Why the Bill Changes Every Month
  • The Mistakes and the Real Limits
  • When It Beats Windows 365 and Plain VDI
  • What to Take Away From All of This

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
